intro: Wilder Thistlenettle is a dwarven miner brooding in a tavern within Stormwind's Dwarven District. The sole survivor of a tragic cave-in deep within the Deadmines, he is haunted by the gruesome fate of his mining company and his brother.

p: Wilder Thistlenettle can be found drowning his sorrows in an alehouse near the southeastern gates of the Dwarven District. Years ago, he joined an expedition into the deep lodes of Moonbrook's Deadmines alongside his brother and their companions. A catastrophic cave-in sealed the rest of the crew in the dark while Wilder barely made it to the surface alive.
